name: Aussie Broadband
summary: Regional Victorian ISP that grew into a major national RSP and ASX-listed telecom group. Formed (Aussie Broadband Ltd, ACN 132 090 192) from the amalgamation of two 2003-era Gippsland broadband ISPs: Westvic Broadband Pty Ltd (ACN 106 835 947, Warrnambool; retail, trading as '.Aussie Broadband') and Wideband Networks Pty Ltd (ACN 097 649 851, Traralgon; wireless/ADSL retail ISP for East Gippsland; renamed Aussie Fibre Pty Ltd 2024, now the group's fibre/wholesale arm).

events.details: Founded via amalgamation of Westvic Broadband and Wideband Networks (both trading since 2003) under Aussie Broadband Ltd (ACN 132 090 192, Traralgon VIC 3840). Operating entities: Westvic Broadband Pty Ltd (ACN 106 835 947, reg 28 Oct 2003 Warrnambool 3280; Traralgon 3840 from 27 Nov 2008; business name '.AUSSIE BROADBAND' from 02 Aug 2007 - the retail RSP), and Wideband Networks Pty Ltd (ACN 097 649 851, ABN 11 097 649 851, reg 27 Feb 2003 Traralgon; regional retail ISP 2003-2008: HiBIS wireless broadband (Mt Taylor, Bairnsdale/East Gippsland), ADSL, VoIP 'Wideband Voice', web hosting; renamed Aussie Fibre Pty Ltd 09 Oct 2024 - now the group's fibre/wholesale arm).
